subject: Synthex onboarding: procurement route, SOC 2 & next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@synthex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Synthex onboarding: procurement route, SOC 2 & next steps

Hi Alyssa — great call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the pilot procurement and security gating.

Call highlights (short):
- Pilot scope: 3-month evaluation, 2 dedicated API keys, up to 50k tokens/day peak.
- Commercial preference: your team indicated procurement usually flows via PO for pilots, but payment by card is sometimes used for faster pilots.
- Security asks: SOC 2 Type II report and DPA signature are the two primary gating items for your InfoSec team; you also mentioned a vendor questionnaire.

Actions / asks from Synthex:
1) Confirm preferred payment path: PO (paperflow) vs corporate card vs marketplace purchase. If PO, what is the expected PO issuance timeline?
2) Please attach the completed security questionnaire (or the XLS we sent) so our security team can triage the gaps.
3) Any internal procurement contacts we should loop in (procurement@synthex.com or a named contact)?

What Redwood will do:
- Attached: draft SOW (Synthex_SOW_draft_v1.pdf) and a copy of our SOC 2 summary.
- We can accept a standard PO routed to our finance team; Ben will confirm invoicing details and DocuSign flow.
- Marissa will take the security questionnaire and follow up on DPA/DSP questions.

Proposed mutual action plan (dates):
- By Wed, 24 Mar: Synthex confirms payment path + returns questionnaire.
- By Fri, 26 Mar: Redwood provides SOC2 artifact link and proposed DPA.
- Target week of 29 Mar: complete procurement signature / issue PO / enable pilot keys.

If a marketplace purchase is preferable (for faster procurement), we can explore that — we have marketplace listings but need to confirm credit/entitlement timing.

Thanks — copying Ben and Marissa to answer the invoicing and security specifics.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Synthex_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (34 KB), Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (120 KB, summary)

Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@synthex.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Synthex onboarding: procurement route, SOC 2 & next steps

Thanks Vivek — helpful recap. A few clarifications from procurement/security here: 

- Procurement: We prefer PO for anything over $5k, so pilot will likely go via PO. Timeline wise, our standard PO process is 2–3 weeks once legal signs off.
- Security: We need the SOC 2 Type II report (not just a summary) and a signed DPA. I attached our vendor questionnaire (Vendor_Risk_Form_Synthex.xlsx).
- Marketplace: we have a marketplace buying card but it usually takes internal approvals and often doesn't save time for pilots. Would still consider if it expedites start.

Can Ben confirm invoicing and DocuSign process? If Redwood can provide the SOC2 artifact and DPA link today/tomorrow that helps us queue legal.

Best,
Alyssa Turner
Sr. Procurement Manager | Synthex Health
alyssa.turner@synthex.com
Attachment: Vendor_Risk_Form_Synthex.xlsx

Hi Alyssa — Marissa on the security/compliance side. Appreciate the vendor questionnaire — I started a quick pass and have a few notes.

Top items we typically need to close for pilot gating:
- SOC 2 Type II report (we can provide under NDA). Please tell us the names/emails of the recipients who will receive the full report.
- Signed DPA (we can provide a DocuSign link).
- Completed vendor questionnaire: I’ll fill the technical controls sheet where we can and flag gaps. For anything marked as 'needs evidence' we usually ask for:
  - Data flow diagram (one-page diagram showing where customer data is stored / processed)
  - Subprocessor list (CSV or PDF)
  - Retention policy excerpt for logs and backups

Practical timeline: if Synthex returns the completed questionnaire + recipients for SOC2 by Thu 25 Mar, we can typically close the security review within ~7–10 business days (depending on follow-ups). If procurement can issue a PO in that window we can match to the MAP Vivek proposed.

Next steps for Alyssa / Jordan:
1) Confirm the procurement route (PO vs marketplace) by Thu 25 Mar.
2) Provide the contact email(s) who should receive the SOC 2 report.
3) Return the vendor questionnaire (completed where possible).

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min security triage with your InfoSec folks this week. Available slots: Wed 24 Mar 10:00–11:00 or Thu 25 Mar 14:00–15:00 (PST).

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
